ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three vertical straight lines, labeled ℓ, m, n respectively; they have the same arrow markings, indicating that the three straight lines are parallel to each other. An oblique line t passes through these three parallel lines from upper left to lower right. At the intersection of line ℓ and oblique line t, ∠3 is located on the right side of line ℓ and below oblique line t, and is an interior angle between ℓ and n. At the intersection of line n and oblique line t, ∠9 is located on the left side of line n and above oblique line t, and is also an interior angle between ℓ and n. Reasoning: Because ℓ and n are parallel, and t is a transversal, ∠3 and ∠9 are alternate interior angles, and alternate interior angles are equal. Given m∠9 = 75, therefore m∠3 = 75.

raw_record.question_text: In the figure, $m \angle 9 = 75$. Find the measure of $\angle 3$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the vertical lines labeled l, m, and n have matching arrow markings, indicating they are parallel, and the slanted line t is a transversal crossing them. At line l, angle 3 is the interior angle below the transversal and to the right of l. At line n, angle 9 is the interior angle above the transversal and to the left of n. From the text, use m∠9 = 75 and the target is m∠3. Since lines l and n are parallel, ∠9 and ∠3 are alternate interior angles, so they are congruent. Therefore m∠3 = 75.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有三条竖直直线，分别标为 ℓ、m、n，它们带有相同的箭头标记，表示三条直线互相平行。一条斜线 t 从左上向右下穿过这三条平行线。在直线 ℓ 与斜线 t 的交点处，∠3 位于直线 ℓ 的右侧、斜线 t 的下方，是 ℓ 与 n 之间的内角。在直线 n 与斜线 t 的交点处，∠9 位于直线 n 的左侧、斜线 t 的上方，也是 ℓ 与 n 之间的内角。推理：因为 ℓ 和 n 平行，t 是截线，所以 ∠3 和 ∠9 是内错角，内错角相等。已知 m∠9 = 75，因此 m∠3 = 75。
